main_text.l: stit in sola vnione partium, quæ mittun-
quòd miscibilia, hoc est elementa dum
in mixto manere ignem, aquam, terram,
&c. Hoc suppositò, quod etiam suo loco
ergo dum fit mixtio, non generatur de
nouo alia forma substantialis. Probo con-
rum, an in alia? non primum, alioquin
duæ formæ totales in vna, eademque ma-
teria simul forent, quod repugnat. Sed
neque secundum, in mixto enim non alia
materia est, quàm quæ subest formis ele-
mentorum. Ergo cum in ea produci ne-
queat forma, nulla de nouo produce-
tum, ne tunc materia prima sine forma
lis de nouo fit, ergo. Maior admittitur.

page.notes: Right margin notes not legible enough to transcribe reliably; the small marginal reference marks (the signs after "dum", "non", "reuera", "de") and the note at the top of the right margin were not confidently read. Faint background text at the bottom right is a digitiser's mark and was omitted. The catchword "Mi-" is the start of the next page's word.
